title: Removing duplicates keeps only the duplicates
summary: `unique(items)` should return a new list with each value only once, in the order it first appeared. `unique([1, 2, 2, 3, 1])` should return `[1, 2, 3]`, but right now it returns an empty list.
hint: Read the `if` line out loud. When should an item be added to `result`?
